name: Pointing Mirror Guy
look: A soft digital illustration of a young man with brown hair and a pale yellow shirt pointing at his reflection in a wood-framed mirror. The reflection, tinted blue and looking sterner with stubble, points back so their fingertips nearly touch.
use: The man is labeled as yourself and the caption is what you say to your reflection: a pep talk, a confession, or blame for something you did to yourself.
slots: who is at the mirror (the man, left)
what he says or who the reflection is (the reflection, right)
examples: You're the reason we'll be tired tomorrow
The guy who said he'd remember it without writing it down
